dct_title_s: Eastern archipelago, Java central portion : from the Netherlands Government charts to 1911 with corrections to 1933
dct_description_sm: Nautical chart of central Java. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. Depth shown by bathymetric soundings.
In lower left margin: B.A. small corrections 1934-193-438 ... 1941-1229-1426. Printed by H.O. Dec. '41, Apr. '42.
In upper left margin: Hydrographic Office, U.S. Navy emergency reproduction of B.A. chart.
"Reproduced by the U.S. Hydrographic Office from British Admiralty chart with the permission of the Controller, H.M. Stationery Office and Hydrographer of the Royal Navy."
dct_publisher_sm: Published at the Admiralty, 18th January 1934, under the superintendence of Captain J.A. Edgell, O.B.E.R.N. Hydrographer
